ec2mud-main/package.json:
{
  "name": "ec2mud",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Multi-user dungeon (MUD) game server hosted on AWS EC2",
  "private": true,
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": "SuperInstance",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/SuperInstance/ec2mud#readme",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/SuperInstance/ec2mud.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/SuperInstance/ec2mud/issues"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev -p 3005",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "next lint",
    "type-check": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "mud": "npx tsx src/lib/standalone-mud.ts",
    "bridge": "npx tsx src/lib/ws-bridge.ts",
    "dev:all": "concurrently 'next dev -p 3005' 'npx tsx src/lib/standalone-mud.ts'"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "concurrently": "^9.2.1",
    "lucide-react": "^0.525.0",
    "next": "15.3.5",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "socket.io": "^4.8.1",
    "socket.io-client": "^4.8.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.3.1",
    "tsx": "^4.21.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^22.0.0",
    "@types/react": "^19",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19",
    "eslint": "^9",
    "eslint-config-next": "15.3.5",
    "tailwindcss": "^4",
    "typescript": "^5",
    "vitest": "^4.1.10"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18.0.0",
    "pnpm": ">=8.0.0"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "superinstance",
    "mud",
    "game",
    "multiplayer",
    "ec2",
    "aws",
    "socket.io",
    "realtime"
  ]
}
